title: Louis Nelson's birth and musical family
summary: Nelson gives his 1902 birth and describes his pianist mother, doctor father and brother George.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: All right, we're rolling. What's your name?
I see. And where were you born?
Born here in New Orleans, 1419, 2 Road Street, September 17, 1902.
And what about your family? Did anybody in your family play?
Yes, my mother played. My father, he played all. So my mother, she was a graduate from the Boston Conservatory of Music. She was a pianist.
And your father, what did he do?
He played all around the church and he was a medical doctor.
Did he read music? He studied, huh, too? Yes, yes. Didn't you have a brother, too?
Yes, he played saxophone a little.
